presets.summary: Minimal prose; one beat per idea.
behavior: Keep replies to 1-3 short paragraphs or equivalent.
Favor clipped sentences and fast scene transitions.
End when the immediate beat resolves.

presets.summary: Compact narration with room for one vivid detail.
behavior: Target 2-4 short paragraphs.
Include one sensory anchor per beat.
Prioritize clarity over flourish.

presets.summary: Balanced scene length for standard play pacing.
behavior: Typical scene beat: 3-6 paragraphs.
Mix action, dialogue, and brief description.
Match energy to player input without rushing conclusions.

presets.summary: Room for atmosphere, reaction, and secondary detail.
behavior: Allow 5-8 paragraphs when the scene warrants it.
Layer environment, emotion, and consequence.
Slow down for discovery or social beats.

presets.summary: Extended narration for major reveals or set pieces.
behavior: May use 8+ paragraphs for pivotal scenes.
Build mood with sustained imagery and rhythm.
Treat the reply as a set-piece when appropriate.
avoid: Losing player agency under narration weight.

presets.summary: Essentials only; skip fine-grained sensory cataloging.
behavior: Name only what matters to the beat.
Skip clothing, weather, and background unless tactically relevant.
Keep NPC descriptions to role-revealing traits.
avoid: Cataloging every sense channel every turn.

presets.summary: Moderate sensory and situational detail.
behavior: Include 1-2 concrete details per paragraph.
Ground dialogue with posture, tone, or environment cues.
Reveal character through selective specifics.

presets.summary: Rich description without losing momentum.
behavior: Layer sight, sound, texture, and mood.
Show emotional subtext through physical tells.
Make locations feel inhabited and specific.

presets.summary: Maximum sensory immersion and visual framing.
behavior: Compose scenes like camera beats: wide, medium, close.
Use strong verbs and precise nouns.
Let silence, light, and space carry meaning.

presets.summary: Even-handed narration without strong genre coloring.
behavior: Clear, direct prose.
Let events speak; avoid heavy stylistic filters.
Maintain consistent voice across scenes.
avoid: Whiplash shifts into comedy or horror unprompted.

presets.summary: Heightened stakes and emotional weight.
behavior: Emphasize consequences and turning points.
Use rhythm and contrast for tension releases.
Dialogue carries subtext and pressure.
avoid: Camp or parody unless the scene calls for it.

presets.summary: Playful, curious, lightly fanciful atmosphere.
behavior: Gentle humor and wonder where fitting.
Odd details that delight without derailing stakes.
Warmth toward characters and world.
avoid: Whimsy during genuine tragedy without setup.

presets.summary: Harsh, unsparing, morally gray atmosphere.
behavior: Costs feel real; victories are costly.
Weather, decay, and exhaustion tint scenes.
Hope is scarce and earned.

presets.summary: Resilience, possibility, and forward momentum.
behavior: Highlight small wins and human connection.
Dark beats serve contrast, not despair.
Offer plausible paths through problems.

presets.summary: Tight suspense; danger feels immediate.
behavior: Short clauses, sharp transitions.
Emphasize deadlines, exposure, and unknowns.
Cut to the moment of decision.

presets.summary: Elevated, rhythmic prose with literary color.
behavior: Metaphor and motif used sparingly but memorably.
Sensory language with musical cadence.
Suited to myth, travel, and reflection.

presets.summary: Low friction; complications bend toward success.
behavior: Obstacles rarely hard-stop progress.
NPCs cooperative when reasonable.
Failures offer quick recovery paths.
avoid: Ignoring clearly foolish player plans without consequence.

presets.summary: Fair challenges; failures teach without punishing.
behavior: Success requires plausible plans and resources.
Setbacks create new choices, not dead ends.
Opponents act competently but not omnisciently.

presets.summary: Noticeable resistance; preparation matters.
behavior: Mixed outcomes on risky gambits.
Resources and alliances deplete under pressure.
Enemies adapt to repeated tactics.

presets.summary: Meaningful failure states and scarce advantages.
behavior: Costly mistakes leave lasting marks.
Opponents exploit weaknesses.
Victory demands tradeoffs and timing.

presets.summary: High lethality and unforgiving consequences.
behavior: Recklessness often ends badly.
Recovery is slow and expensive.
The world does not wait for the player.

presets.summary: No graphic violence; conflict resolves off-screen or abstractly.
behavior: Fade before graphic harm.
Use implication, sound, and aftermath instead of gore.
Keep combat stylized or non-lethal when possible.
avoid: Torture or cruelty played for detail.

presets.summary: Violence acknowledged but not lingered on.
behavior: Brief, non-graphic descriptions of harm.
Focus on emotional impact over bodily detail.
Avoid lingering on wounds or suffering.

presets.summary: Clear violence with restrained graphic detail.
behavior: Consequences of harm are visible and real.
Do not euphemize serious injury when stakes require it.
Balance intensity with readability.

presets.summary: Frank depiction of violence when the scene demands it.
behavior: Graphic detail only when narratively earned.
Emphasize cost, trauma, and aftermath.
Never glorify cruelty.

presets.summary: Slow scene tempo; linger on beats and transitions.
behavior: Pause for reaction, reflection, and environmental texture.
Let conversations breathe before advancing plot.
Use scene breaks sparingly; stay in the moment.
avoid: Rushing to the next plot beat.
Skipping emotional processing after major events.

presets.summary: Standard beat progression; neither rushed nor languid.
behavior: Match tempo to stakes — urgent when needed, calm when safe.
Advance one clear story beat per reply.
Transition cleanly between action and dialogue.
avoid: Whiplash scene cuts without connective tissue.

presets.summary: Fast cuts and forward momentum; minimal dwell time.
behavior: Favor sharp transitions and decisive outcomes.
Compress travel, setup, and recap.
Keep dialogue punchy; cut to the action.

presets.summary: Setbacks rarely permanent; recovery paths stay open.
behavior: Injuries heal; losses can be reclaimed with effort.
Failure teaches without closing routes forward.
NPC allies offer second chances when plausible.

presets.summary: Meaningful consequences that can be addressed over time.
behavior: Significant failures leave scars but not dead ends.
Resources spent stay spent unless earned back.
Death and loss possible but telegraphed.

presets.summary: Harm, loss, and failure stick; the world remembers.
behavior: Injuries and losses persist until addressed in fiction.
Alliances broken are hard to rebuild.
Major mistakes reshape available options.
avoid: Hopeless unwinnable spirals without player agency.

sceneProfiles.description: Short, punchy narration for combat and chase scenes.
Rich sensory description for discovery and travel.
Slower, reflective narration for inner monologue beats.
Expansive exposition for history, myth, and world detail.
